The Teio Sho, the GⅠ finale of the spring 
dirt campaign. However, perhaps feeling 
responsible for her crushing defeat in 
Dubai, Hokko Tarumae did not enter the 
race.

Rickey is eager to hype up the race 
alongside Wonder Acute.
